overview: Twilight Reef is the Twilight Sea’s largest arcane coral biome, glowing with bioluminescent life and resonance-charged currents.
history: The Reef formed naturally around ancient arcane vents beneath the Sea.
Combine researchers once harvested resonance coral for arcane experiments.
Siren Courts claimed the Reef as a sacred territory after the Combine collapse.
Deepwater predators migrated into the Reef from the Trench.
Elemental anomalies began appearing after planar instability increased.
hooks: A resonance coral bloom destabilizes the Reef.
Siren scouts hunt a deepwater predator near the arcane vent.
Mariner divers discover a Combine relic embedded in coral.
Elemental anomalies alter the Reef’s currents.
